source_instruction: i looking a super soft fleece throw for  small pets size;40*30 inch
query: I spent the whole walk over here watching a tiny golden retriever puppy chase a dandelion fluff across the sidewalk, tripping over its own paws every three steps like it was still figuring out how all four legs worked. It kept stopping to sniff every crack in the pavement, like it was convinced there was a whole secret stash of treats hidden just under the concrete, and its owner kept laughing so hard they had to stop walking for a minute every time the puppy face-planted into a patch of clover. By the time I got to the store entrance, the puppy had curled up in its owner’s arms, fast asleep with its little tongue sticking out, and it made me think about how nice soft, cozy little spots are for small, sleepy creatures. I’ve heard the throw blankets section carries sherpa throws that are super soft, including the 40"x30" extra small size made for pets. I’ve heard those options come at a reasonable price point that works for that exact use case, with nothing that feels overpriced for the small size I’m thinking of.
